newsitem.title: THAILAND: FinOne, Thai Danu to tie merger.
newsitem.headline: FinOne, Thai Danu to tie merger.

text.p: Finance One Plc and Thai Danu Bank Plc will sign a memorandum of understanding on their planned friendly merger on Friday, but it would likely take months to work out its details, Thai Danu officials said.

Officials of the two firms have said the merged company would probably retain the name of Thai Danu, but would need to relinguish some finance and securities business licences that Finance One obtained from the Bank of Thailand.
Krairit Uchukanonchai, president of Finance One's Thana One Plc unit, said last weekend that the firm still had not decided which of its numerous units would be included in the merger.
"We will keep the Thai Danu name, which is an asset because of its goodwill and existing clientele. We would not need any promotional budget for a new corporate name," he told Reuters.

An official of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said on Thursday that some top executives of Finance One and its One Holding Plc unit and their families sold part of their shares and warrants in the two firms ahead the merger announcement early this month.

According to SEC records, Finance One president Pin Chakkaphak and his family sold during August-November last year about 2.32 million shares and 6,500 warrants of his company that were held in their names.
The official said the executives reported the sales to the regulatory watchdog agency, but said she had no knowledge on whether the transactions violated any insider trading rules.
